units.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 6) termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation or citizenship of a foreign state that is a party to an international treaty of the Russian Federation under which a foreign citizen has the right to be elected to local self-government bodies; possession of citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state or of a residence permit or other document confirming the right of a citizen of the Russian Federation, or of a foreign citizen entitled under an international treaty of the Russian Federation to be elected to local self-government bodies, to permanent residence in a foreign state, unless otherwise provided for by an international treaty of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint 6 Point 1 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 7) deleted. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 25.10.2011 No. 67/47;
units.label: Subpoint 7 Point 1 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 8) early termination of the powers of the City Duma;
units.label: Subpoint 8 Point 1 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 9) holding a post or carrying out activities incompatible with the status of a deputy of the City Duma;
units.label: Subpoint 9 Point 1 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 10) conscription for military service or assignment to alternative civilian service replacing it;
units.label: Subpoint 10 Point 1 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 11) death;
units.label: Subpoint 11 Point 1 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 11-1) acquisition of foreign-agent status;
units.label: Subpoint 11-1 Point 1 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 12) other cases established by federal laws.
units.label: Subpoint 12 Point 1 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: The powers of a deputy of the City Duma terminate early by a decision of the City Duma if the deputy is absent without valid reasons from all meetings of the City Duma for six consecutive months.
units.label: Subpoint 12 Point 1 Art. 47 · “The powers of a deputy of the City Duma terminate early by a…”

units.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 1-1. A decision of the City Duma on early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma is adopted no later than 30 days after the ground for early termination arises; if that ground arises between sessions of the City Duma, the decision is adopted no later than three months after the ground arises.
units.label: Point 1-1 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 2. A decision on early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma on the grounds provided for in subpoints 1 and 9 of point 1 of this Article of the Charter is adopted by the City Duma on the basis of the deputy’s written application.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 3. In the event of early termination of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma, municipal by-elections are held according to the procedure and within the time limits established by electoral legislation.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 47

units.locator: Chapter VII. MUNICIPAL LEGAL ACTS
units.text: Chapter VII. MUNICIPAL LEGAL ACTS
units.label: Chapter VII. MUNICIPAL LEGAL ACTS

units.locator: Article 48. Rule-making activities
units.text: Article 48. Rule-making activities
units.label: Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Rule-making activities
units.text: 1. Municipal legal acts on matters of local significance are adopted directly by the population of the municipality and by local self-government bodies and officials.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Rule-making activities
units.text: 2. On matters concerning the exercise of specific state powers transferred to local self-government bodies by federal laws or laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast, municipal legal acts may be adopted on the basis of, and to implement, provisions established by the corresponding federal laws or laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Rule-making activities
units.text: 3. Municipal legal acts adopted by the population and local self-government bodies and officials are binding throughout the territory of the municipality.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Rule-making activities
units.text: Citizens, heads of organizations and officials of state authorities and local self-government bodies bear liability for failure to comply with municipal legal acts in accordance with federal law and the law of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 48 · “Citizens, heads of organizations and officials of state…”

units.locator: Article 48. Rule-making activities
units.text: 4. Municipal legal acts adopted by the population and local self-government bodies and officials must not contradict the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast, or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation and Sverdlovsk Oblast.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Rule-making activities
units.text: 5. Municipal legal acts may be repealed or their operation suspended by the local self-government bodies or officials that adopted (issued) the corresponding act; where such bodies or offices have been abolished or the list of their powers has changed, by the local self-government bodies or officials whose powers, at the time of repeal or suspension, include adopting (issuing) the corresponding municipal legal act; and also by a court. Insofar as an act regulates the exercise by local self-government bodies of specific state powers transferred to them by federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast, it may also be repealed or suspended by an authorized state authority of the Russian Federation (an authorized state authority of Sverdlovsk Oblast).
units.label: Point 5 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Rule-making activities
units.text: 6. Municipal normative legal acts, including decisions adopted at a local referendum (citizens’ assembly) and formalized as legal acts, must be included in the register of municipal normative legal acts of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts
units.text: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts
units.label: Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts
units.text: 1. The system of municipal legal acts consists of:
units.label: Point 1 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts
units.text: 1) the Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” and decisions adopted at a local referendum and formalized as legal acts;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 1 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts
units.text: 2) decisions of the City Duma;
units.label: Subpoint 2 Point 1 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts
units.text: 3) resolutions and executive orders of the Head of Yekaterinburg;
units.label: Subpoint 3 Point 1 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts
units.text: 4) resolutions and executive orders of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg;
units.label: Subpoint 4 Point 1 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts
units.text: 5) executive orders and administrative orders of other officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg provided for by this Charter;
units.label: Subpoint 5 Point 1 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts
units.text: 6) resolutions and executive orders of the Chamber of Accounts;
units.label: Subpoint 6 Point 1 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts
units.text: 7) resolutions and executive orders of the Chair of the City Duma.
units.label: Subpoint 7 Point 1 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts
units.text: 2. The Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” and decisions adopted at a local referendum and formalized as legal acts have the highest legal force within the system of municipal legal acts, have direct effect and apply throughout the territory of the municipality.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts
units.text: 3. Other municipal legal acts must not contradict this Charter or legal acts adopted at a local referendum.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts
units.text: 4. Draft municipal legal acts may be introduced by the Head of Yekaterinburg, deputies of the City Duma, the Chamber of Accounts, bodies of territorial public self-government, the prosecutor of the City of Yekaterinburg and citizens’ initiative groups.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. System of municipal legal acts
units.text: 5. The procedure for introducing draft municipal legal acts and the list and form of accompanying documents are established by the Head of Yekaterinburg and the City Duma to whom such drafts are submitted for consideration.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 49

units.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts
units.text: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts
units.label: Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts
units.text: 1. Municipal legal acts enter into force according to the procedure established by this Charter, except for decisions of the City Duma on taxes and levies, which enter into force in accordance with the Tax Code of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts
units.text: 2. Municipal normative legal acts affecting human and civil rights, freedoms and duties, municipal normative legal acts establishing the legal status of organizations founded by the municipality, and agreements concluded between local self-government bodies enter into force after their official promulgation.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts
units.text: 3. Promulgation of a municipal legal act, including an agreement concluded between local self-government bodies, means:
units.label: Point 3 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts
units.text: 1) official publication of the municipal legal act;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 3 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts
units.text: 2) placing the municipal legal act in locations accessible to an unrestricted range of persons (premises of state bodies, local self-government bodies, state and municipal libraries, and other places open to visitors);
units.label: Subpoint 2 Point 3 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts
units.text: 3) posting it on the municipality’s official website on the Internet information and telecommunications network.
units.label: Subpoint 3 Point 3 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts
units.text: 4. Official publication of a municipal legal act, including an agreement concluded between local self-government bodies, is its first full-text publication in the ‘Bulletin of the Yekaterinburg City Duma’ or the ‘Yekaterinburg Bulletin’.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts
units.text: 5. In accordance with federal legislation, municipal legal acts or individual provisions thereof containing information whose dissemination is restricted by federal law are not subject to promulgation.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts
units.text: Municipal legal acts or individual provisions thereof that are not subject to promulgation under the first paragraph of this point must be communicated to the local self-government bodies, their officials and organizations to which those municipal legal acts apply.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 50 · “Municipal legal acts or individual provisions thereof that are…”

units.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts
units.text: 6. Non-normative municipal legal acts may be promulgated by a decision of the municipality’s local self-government bodies and officials that adopted (issued) them.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Entry into force and promulgation of municipal legal acts
units.text: 7. If implementing a decision adopted through the direct expression of will of the municipality’s population additionally requires adoption (issuance) of a municipal legal act, the City Duma or the Head of Yekaterinburg whose competence includes adopting (issuing) that act must, within 15 days after the decision adopted at the local referendum enters into force, determine the time limit for preparing and adopting the corresponding municipal legal act. That time limit may not exceed three months.
units.label: Point 7 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.label: Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 1. In accordance with federal legislation, the Charter of the municipality determines:
units.label: Point 1 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 1) the name of the municipality;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 1 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 2) the list of matters of local significance;
units.label: Subpoint 2 Point 1 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 3) the forms, procedure and guarantees of public participation in resolving matters of local significance, including through the formation of territorial public self-government bodies;
units.label: Subpoint 3 Point 1 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 4) the structure and procedure for forming local self-government bodies;
units.label: Subpoint 4 Point 1 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 5) the names and powers of elected and other local self-government bodies and local self-government officials;
units.label: Subpoint 5 Point 1 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 6) the types of municipal legal acts and the procedures for their adoption (issuance), official publication (promulgation) and entry into force;
units.label: Subpoint 6 Point 1 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 7) the terms of office of the City Duma, the Head of Yekaterinburg and deputies of the City Duma, and the grounds and procedure for termination of their powers;
units.label: Subpoint 7 Point 1 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 8) the types of liability of the City Duma, the Head of Yekaterinburg and deputies of the City Duma, the grounds for such liability and the procedure for resolving the corresponding matters;
units.label: Subpoint 8 Point 1 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 9) the procedure for preparing and considering the draft municipal budget, approving and executing the municipal budget, monitoring its execution, and preparing and approving the report on execution of the municipal budget in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint 9 Point 1 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 10) the procedure for amending and supplementing this Charter;
units.label: Subpoint 10 Point 1 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 11) other matters concerning the organization of local self-government in accordance with federal and oblast legislation.
units.label: Subpoint 11 Point 1 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 2. The Charter of the municipality and a decision to amend and supplement it are adopted by the City Duma by a two-thirds majority of the established number of deputies of the City Duma.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 3. The draft Charter of the municipality and a draft decision of the City Duma to amend and supplement it must be officially published (promulgated) no later than 30 days before consideration of the adoption of the Charter or amendments and additions to it, together with publication (promulgation) of the procedure established by the City Duma for taking account of proposals on those drafts and for citizens’ participation in their discussion.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: Official publication (promulgation) of the procedure for taking account of proposals on a draft decision of the City Duma to amend and supplement the Charter of the municipality and the procedure for citizens’ participation in its discussion is not required where amendments to the Charter exactly reproduce provisions of the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal laws, the Charter or laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast in order to bring the Charter of the municipality into conformity with those normative legal acts.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 51 · “Official publication (promulgation) of the procedure for taking…”

units.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 4. The Charter of the municipality and decisions on amendments and additions to it are subject to state registration.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”
units.text: 5. The Charter of the municipality and a decision to amend and supplement it must be officially published (promulgated) after state registration and enter into force after their official publication (promulgation). The Head of Yekaterinburg must publish (promulgate) the registered Charter and decision to amend and supplement it within seven days after receipt, from the territorial body of the authorized federal executive body responsible for registration of municipal charters, of the notification provided for in part 6 of Article 4 of Federal Law of 21 July 2005 No. 97-ФЗ ‘On State Registration of Municipal Charters’, confirming the inclusion of information on the municipal charter and the municipal legal act amending it in the State Register of Municipal Charters of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 51
